What is Run & Rave?

Run & Rave is a community-first experience that combines a 3-mile social run with a daytime house music event.

Whether you’re chasing a PR or just showing up for the music, everyone is welcome.

Meet WE THE PEOPLE

WE THE PEOPLE is a melodic house project with one goal: to make people dance. Starting in the college scene at NC State in 2022 they've since gone nationwide playing colleges and venues around the US
